title.description: Report heading, e.g. 'Specification Verification Report' or 'Consistency Report — 2026-07-20'.

author.description: Free-text verifier/validator identity, e.g. 'AI Spec Analyst (Claude Opus 4.6)'.

scope.description: Free-text description of what corpus/specs/layer this report audits, and what it deliberately excludes.

canonical_sources.description: Ordered tie-breaker sources cited when audited artifacts disagree (e.g. constitution, decision log). Opaque strings.

summary.description: Free-text executive summary / narrative overview of the report's outcome.

checks.description: Individual checks/invariant groups run during this audit, each with a pass/fail-style result. May be empty if the report is findings-only.

name.description: Free-text check or invariant-group name, e.g. 'Spec-Plan-Tasks Consistency', 'ADR integrity', 'Error Code Coverage'. Not enumerated — varies per report purpose.

result.description: Generic verdict for this check. Reports using richer wording (e.g. 'PARTIAL PASS') should map to the closest of these.

details.description: Free-text elaboration, evidence, or metrics for this check (e.g. counts, before/after deltas).

findings.description: Issues/gaps surfaced by the audit, each with a severity and description. May be empty if all checks passed clean.

id.description: Free-text finding id/number as written in the source (e.g. 'GAP-1', 'Finding 1', '#3'). Not a fixed pattern — numbering schemes vary per report.

severity.description: Free-standing severity/priority tier. Omit if the source report doesn't grade findings.

description.description: The finding itself, e.g. a contradiction, missing artifact, or coverage gap.

status.description: Free-text current disposition, e.g. 'FIXED', 'Open', 'Not auto-fixed — needs decision'.

resolution.description: Free-text recommended or applied fix / next action for this finding.

refs.description: External references (files, line numbers, tickets, ADRs) as opaque strings — no schema-level meaning attached.

readiness.description: Per-scope readiness/verdict assessment, when the report grades multiple specs/areas individually rather than giving one overall verdict.

scope.description: Free-text name of the spec/area being graded, e.g. 'E1 — Carts Service Foundation'.

verdict.description: Free-text readiness verdict as written in the source, e.g. 'READY', 'READY WITH CAVEATS', 'PASS'.
Free-text overall conclusion for the report as a whole, when a single top-level verdict is stated (distinct from per-scope readiness).

recommended_actions.description: Ordered follow-up actions recommended by the report (e.g. 'Before Sprint Planning', 'Before Go-Live' lists), flattened.

priority.description: Free-text priority/urgency label as written in the source (e.g. 'CRITICAL', 'Before Go-Live'). Not enumerated — varies per report.

owner.description: Generic free-text owner (person, team, or role) — no enumerated values.

notes.description: Catch-all for narrative asides that don't fit the sections above (minor caveats, provenance notes), kept as opaque strings.
